grade_reason: His 2026 campaign platform says AI has the potential to pose an existential risk to humanity itself and calls for strict federal oversight of such technologies; no dismissive statement was found.
notes: Seven web searches ran; none was refused. Searches returned no news reports, interviews or debate remarks by Forstag on AI; the only material found is his campaign platform, read directly at https://samformontana.com/policies/ (raw HTML downloaded and the quotes checked character for character). The platform is undated per section: the page's metadata gives datePublished 2026-02-17 and dateModified 2026-10-09, so the date used is the last-modified date and the text may have been written earlier in 2026; either way it is a 2026 statement. A second bullet on the same page reads 'Strict Federal Oversight of technologies with the potential to pose an existential risk to our economy and to humanity.' (not listed separately, as it repeats the first). Reviewer judgement: the wording is hedged ('has the potential to pose') and pairs humanity with 'our economy'; I graded A under ruling 1 (threat to humanity), but B or a boundary flag is arguable. He holds no office yet, so he did not sponsor the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act and no source shows he endorsed it. A PulseAugur aggregator page (https://pulseaugur.com/cluster/39163) said Forstag faced scrutiny over his stance on Montana AI data centers, but it returned HTTP 403 and was not used. No search was restricted to an official site because he has no house.gov site; the campaign site was opened directly instead.
